ValidationRule.description: SFM-12912: Desired Features or Elevated Functionality is selected but the Desired Features picklist is blank
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.skipValidation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", OR( AND( ISCHANGED(Cancellation_Subreason__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Desired Features"), ISPICKVAL(Cancellation_Subreason__c , "Elevated Functionality") ) ), AND( ISCHANGED(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c), OR( ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Desired Features"), ISPICKVAL(Secondary_Cancellation_Subreason__c, "Elevated Functionality") ) ) ), ISBLANK(Desired_Features__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: What features does the office want?
